instructor: Asst. Prof. Dr. Huda Lafta Majeed
subject: 01_Cyber_Security
topic: Secure configuration, hardening, monitoring and incident response

questions.question: What is the goal of configuration hardening?
options: Adding more authentication factors to logins.
Minimising the attack surface the application presents.
Maximising the number of security tools deployed.
Encrypting every field in the database.
options_ar: تقليل سطح الهجوم اللي يعرضه التطبيق.
options_en: Adding more authentication factors to logins.
Minimising the attack surface the application presents.
Maximising the number of security tools deployed.
Encrypting every field in the database.
questions.explanation: It closes what does not need to be open, so the attacker has fewer reachable things to attack.
questions.explanation_ar: يسكّر اللي ما يحتاج يكون مفتوحاً، فيبقى للمهاجم أشياء أقل يقدر يوصلها.

questions.question: Why does the chapter recommend disabling unused services?
questions.question_ar: ليش يوصي الفصل بتعطيل الخدمات غير المستخدمة؟
options: Because each running service is a potential entry point.
Because unused services consume valuable licence seats.
Because they slow down the whole build pipeline.
Because they become impossible to patch later on.
options_ar: لأن كل خدمة شغّالة نقطة دخول محتملة.
لأن الخدمات غير المستخدمة تستهلك مقاعد ترخيص.
options_en: Because each running service is a potential entry point.
Because unused services consume valuable licence seats.
Because they slow down the whole build pipeline.
Because they become impossible to patch later on.
questions.explanation: A service nobody uses still listens, still parses input and still needs patching, so it is pure downside.
questions.explanation_ar: الخدمة اللي ما يستخدمها أحد تظل تسمع وتظل تحلّل مدخلات وتظل تحتاج ترقيع، فما عندها إلا الضرر.

questions.question: What does the principle of least functionality mean?
options: Giving users the fewest permissions possible.
Logging the fewest events required by law.
Deploying the fewest servers that can cope.
Running only the features and protocols needed.
options_ar: تسجيل أقل عدد أحداث يفرضه القانون.
options_en: Giving users the fewest permissions possible.
Logging the fewest events required by law.
Deploying the fewest servers that can cope.
Running only the features and protocols needed.
questions.explanation: It is about the software's own surface — which features and protocols are enabled — rather than about user permissions.
questions.explanation_ar: يتعلّق بسطح البرمجية نفسها — أي ميزات وبروتوكولات مفعّلة — مو بصلاحيات المستخدم.

questions.question: Which transport requirement does the chapter impose for hardening?
questions.question_ar: أي شرط نقل يفرضه الفصل للتقوية؟
options: Disable TLS and rely on network isolation.
Use TLS only for authentication endpoints.
Enforce TLS 1.3 for all communications.
Allow TLS 1.0 for backward compatibility.
options_ar: تعطيل TLS والاعتماد على عزل الشبكة.
السماح بـ TLS 1.0 للتوافق مع القديم.
options_en: Disable TLS and rely on network isolation.
Use TLS only for authentication endpoints.
Enforce TLS 1.3 for all communications.
Allow TLS 1.0 for backward compatibility.
questions.explanation: Modern TLS removes the legacy protocol versions and weak cipher suites that older deployments still permit.
questions.explanation_ar: TLS الحديث يحذف إصدارات البروتوكول القديمة ومجموعات التشفير الضعيفة اللي ما زالت النشرات القديمة تسمح بها.

questions.question: How is attack surface reduction expressed for hardening?
questions.question_ar: كيف يُعبَّر عن تقليل سطح الهجوم للتقوية؟
options: Total endpoints divided by the exposed ones.
One minus exposed endpoints over total endpoints.
Exposed endpoints over the total number of endpoints.
One plus exposed endpoints over total endpoints.
options_ar: واحد ناقص النقاط المكشوفة على الإجمالي.
واحد زائد النقاط المكشوفة على الإجمالي.
options_en: Total endpoints divided by the exposed ones.
One minus exposed endpoints over total endpoints.
Exposed endpoints over the total number of endpoints.
One plus exposed endpoints over total endpoints.
questions.explanation: The score is the fraction of the surface that has been closed, so it rises as exposure falls.
questions.explanation_ar: الدرجة هي نسبة السطح اللي انسكّر، فترتفع كل ما قلّ التعرّض.

questions.question: What does a value approaching one indicate?
questions.question_ar: شنو تدلّ عليه قيمة تقترب من الواحد؟
options: Near-optimal hardening of the configuration.
Almost every endpoint is exposed to attack.
The application has no endpoints at all.
The model has been applied incorrectly.
options_en: Near-optimal hardening of the configuration.
Almost every endpoint is exposed to attack.
The application has no endpoints at all.
The model has been applied incorrectly.
questions.explanation: A score near one means almost nothing exploitable remains reachable, which is the objective of hardening.
questions.explanation_ar: درجة قرب الواحد تعني إن تقريباً ماكو شي قابل للاستغلال يبقى قابلاً للوصول، وهذا هدف التقوية.

questions.question: What does a score of zero mean?
options: The application is perfectly hardened already.
Only half of the endpoints are reachable.
The endpoint count could not be measured.
Every endpoint is exposed, so nothing is hardened.
options_en: The application is perfectly hardened already.
Only half of the endpoints are reachable.
The endpoint count could not be measured.
Every endpoint is exposed, so nothing is hardened.
questions.explanation: With the whole surface open there is nothing closed, which is the state hardening is meant to change.
questions.explanation_ar: بسطح مفتوح بالكامل ماكو شي مسكّر، وهذي الحالة اللي جاية التقوية تغيّرها.

questions.question: Why can closing a service be better than patching its flaw?
questions.question_ar: ليش إغلاق خدمة يقدر يكون أفضل من ترقيع عيبها؟
options: Because patches introduce new vulnerabilities.
Because scanners cannot detect closed ports.
Because an unreachable flaw cannot be exploited at all.
Because closing a service is always cheaper.
options_ar: لأن الفاحصات ما تكشف المنافذ المسكّرة.
لأن عيباً غير قابل للوصول ما ينستغل أبداً.
options_en: Because patches introduce new vulnerabilities.
Because scanners cannot detect closed ports.
Because an unreachable flaw cannot be exploited at all.
Because closing a service is always cheaper.
questions.explanation: Removing the exposure removes the attack path itself, which is more durable than fixing one specific defect in reachable code.
questions.explanation_ar: إزالة التعرّض تزيل مسار الهجوم نفسه، وهذا أدوم من إصلاح عيب معيّن بكود يظل قابلاً للوصول.

questions.question: Why does the chapter say prevention alone is insufficient?
questions.question_ar: ليش يقول الفصل إن المنع وحده ما يكفي؟
options: Because prevention has become too expensive.
Because not every attack can be prevented.
Because prevention controls are always misconfigured.
Because attackers never target prevention controls.
options_ar: لأن ما كل هجوم يمكن منعه.
لأن ضوابط المنع دائماً معطوبة الإعداد.
لأن المهاجمين ما يستهدفون ضوابط المنع.
options_en: Because prevention has become too expensive.
Because not every attack can be prevented.
Because prevention controls are always misconfigured.
Because attackers never target prevention controls.
questions.explanation: Since some attacks will get through, the speed of noticing and reacting becomes the real differentiator.
questions.explanation_ar: بما إن بعض الهجمات راح تعدّي، فسرعة الملاحظة وردّ الفعل تصير هي الفرق الحقيقي.

questions.question: What does behavioral analytics do?
options: AI models analyse request anomalies.
Compress logs before archiving them.
Rotate credentials on a schedule.
Patch dependencies automatically.
options_ar: نماذج ذكاء اصطناعي تحلّل شذوذ الطلبات.
options_en: AI models analyse request anomalies.
Compress logs before archiving them.
Rotate credentials on a schedule.
Patch dependencies automatically.
questions.explanation: It looks for requests that do not fit the established pattern rather than only matching known bad signatures.
questions.explanation_ar: يدوّر على الطلبات اللي ما تطابق النمط المعتاد بدل ما يطابق بصمات سيئة معروفة فقط.

questions.question: What does forensic logging provide?
options: Real-time blocking of malicious requests.
Automated containment of infected hosts.
Encrypted backups of the database.
Tamper-proof records for post-incident analysis.
options_ar: سجلات غير قابلة للتلاعب للتحليل بعد الحادث.
options_en: Real-time blocking of malicious requests.
Automated containment of infected hosts.
Encrypted backups of the database.
Tamper-proof records for post-incident analysis.
questions.explanation: After an incident the logs are the evidence, so an attacker who can edit them can erase the story of what happened.
questions.explanation_ar: بعد الحادثة السجلات هي الدليل، فمهاجم يقدر يعدّلها يقدر يمسح قصة اللي صار.

questions.question: What do playbooks and SOAR platforms automate?
questions.question_ar: شنو تؤتمته كتب اللعب ومنصّات SOAR؟
options: Certificate issuance and renewal.
Capacity planning and autoscaling.
Containment and recovery actions.
Code review and merge approvals.
options_en: Certificate issuance and renewal.
Capacity planning and autoscaling.
Containment and recovery actions.
Code review and merge approvals.
questions.explanation: Automating the response shortens the time between noticing an incident and stopping its spread.
questions.explanation_ar: أتمتة الاستجابة تقصّر الزمن بين ملاحظة الحادثة وإيقاف انتشارها.

questions.question: What does mean time to detect measure?
options: The mean cost of a single incident.
The mean time taken to detect an incident.
The mean time taken to recover from it.
The mean number of alerts per day.
options_en: The mean cost of a single incident.
The mean time taken to detect an incident.
The mean time taken to recover from it.
The mean number of alerts per day.
questions.explanation: It is a detection metric, so shortening it means the organisation learns about a breach sooner.
questions.explanation_ar: هو مقياس كشف، فتقصيره يعني إن المؤسسة تعرف بالاختراق أبكر.

questions.question: What does mean time to respond measure?
options: The mean time taken to respond to an incident.
The mean time taken to detect an incident.
The mean time between two failures.
The mean time to deploy a new release.
options_en: The mean time taken to respond to an incident.
The mean time taken to detect an incident.
The mean time between two failures.
The mean time to deploy a new release.
questions.explanation: It is a response metric, so shortening it means the organisation contains damage faster once it knows.
questions.explanation_ar: هو مقياس استجابة، فتقصيره يعني إن المؤسسة تحتوي الضرر أسرع بعد ما تعرف.

questions.question: How is operational resilience expressed from those metrics?
questions.question_ar: كيف تُعبَّر المرونة التشغيلية من تلك المقاييس؟
options: The sum of detection and response time.
The product of detection and response time.
The difference between detection and response time.
One over the sum of detection and response time.
options_ar: واحد على مجموع زمن الكشف والاستجابة.
options_en: The sum of detection and response time.
The product of detection and response time.
The difference between detection and response time.
One over the sum of detection and response time.
questions.explanation: Resilience is defined as the reciprocal, so it is a rate of recovery rather than a duration.
questions.explanation_ar: المرونة معرّفة كمقلوب، فهي معدّل تعافٍ مو مدة.

questions.question: Why is the relation between resilience and those times inverse?
questions.question_ar: ليش العلاقة بين المرونة وتلك الأزمنة عكسية؟
options: Because resilience is measured in the same units.
Because detection and response are unrelated.
Because faster detection and response leave less damage.
Because slower response gives analysts more evidence.
options_ar: لأن الكشف والاستجابة الأسرع يتركان ضرراً أقل.
لأن الاستجابة الأبطأ تعطي المحلّلين أدلة أكثر.
options_en: Because resilience is measured in the same units.
Because detection and response are unrelated.
Because faster detection and response leave less damage.
Because slower response gives analysts more evidence.
questions.explanation: Damage accumulates while an incident is undetected and unhandled, so time is the variable that matters.
questions.explanation_ar: الضرر يتراكم ما دامت الحادثة غير مكتشفة وغير معالَجة، فالزمن هو المتغيّر المهم.

questions.question: Why do organisations invest in SIEM and SOAR for this?
questions.question_ar: ليش تستثمر المؤسسات بـ SIEM و SOAR لهذا الغرض؟
options: Because both reduce the number of endpoints.
Because both shorten detection and response times.
Because both replace the need for prevention.
Because both are required by every standard.
options_ar: لأن الاثنين يقصّران زمن الكشف والاستجابة.
options_en: Because both reduce the number of endpoints.
Because both shorten detection and response times.
Because both replace the need for prevention.
Because both are required by every standard.
questions.explanation: Correlation finds incidents sooner and automation responds sooner, which is exactly the pair the resilience formula rewards.
questions.explanation_ar: الربط يكتشف الحوادث أبكر والأتمتة تستجيب أبكر، وهذي بالضبط الثنائية اللي تكافئها معادلة المرونة.

questions.question: Why must forensic logs be tamper-proof?
questions.question_ar: ليش لازم السجلات الجنائية تكون غير قابلة للتلاعب؟
options: Because they are the evidence after an incident.
Because regulations forbid log rotation.
Because they are the largest data store.
Because analysts read them in real time.
options_en: Because they are the evidence after an incident.
Because regulations forbid log rotation.
Because they are the largest data store.
Because analysts read them in real time.
questions.explanation: If the attacker can rewrite the log, the investigation has no trustworthy timeline to reconstruct.
questions.explanation_ar: لو قدر المهاجم يعيد كتابة السجل، فالتحقيق ما عنده خط زمني موثوق يعيد بناء الأحداث.
